predictions.title: the meter, measured
predictions.claim: The S-1's revenue disclosure will show usage-priced revenue (API plus usage-billed enterprise) at between 40% and 65% of total revenue — a meter, but not the "80% metered" figure that circulated in secondary coverage, and that my own first draft repeated before the model killed it.

predictions.title: the floor exists
predictions.claim: The S-1 will disclose remaining performance obligations, non-cancelable customer commitments, or equivalent contracted future revenue of at least $15 billion.

predictions.title: still pre-profit
predictions.claim: The S-1 will report a GAAP net loss for both the most recent full fiscal year and the most recent interim period.

predictions.title: the margin band
predictions.claim: Gross margin, as disclosed or derivable (revenue less cost of revenue), will fall between 35% and 55% for the most recent period, as reported in GAAP financials, excluding non-GAAP adjustments.

predictions.title: the commitments
predictions.claim: Total disclosed compute and purchase commitments will sum to between $120 billion and $300 billion.

predictions.title: the listing run-rate
predictions.claim: The most recent quarter disclosed in the S-1, annualized by simple multiplication of the most recent quarter × 4, will land between $72 billion and $112 billion — the engine's one-notch band around its $90 billion listing estimate.

predictions.title: the company names the risk
predictions.claim: At least one of the **first ten risk factors** will be dedicated to compute purchase commitments, data-centre capacity, or infrastructure obligations — scored on that risk factor's own heading and subject matter, not on an exact phrase, so a differently worded heading plainly about the same obligation counts and a passing mention buried inside an unrelated risk does not.

predictions.title: the pricing bracket
predictions.claim: The IPO will price at a fully diluted market capitalization (offer price × fully diluted shares per the prospectus cover) between **$1.2 trillion and $2.2 trillion** — clear of the $965 billion Series H mark by a real margin, and below the euphoria case. Equivalently, between roughly 13× and 24× the S-1's annualized most recent quarter. If the two tests disagree, because the disclosed run-rate lands outside the $72–112 billion band of Prediction 6, **the dollar bracket governs**.

predictions.title: the gross-or-net question
predictions.claim: . The S-1's revenue-recognition note will state whether the company acts as principal or agent on cloud-resold or partner-distributed revenue — the disclosure that resolves the $169 billion restatement branch in Figure 2.

predictions.title: the path base rate
predictions.claim: Within 26 weeks of listing, the shares will trade below their first-day closing price at least once — 24 of the 26 comparable listings did.

resolution_rules.ipo_definition: the first public listing of Anthropic common equity on a US national exchange, whether by traditional IPO, direct listing, or de-SPAC; an acquisition or continued private status is not a listing
resolution_rules.no_listing_path: if there is never a listing, the pricing (8) and path (10) predictions resolve unresolvable; document predictions still score against any publicly filed S-1
resolution_rules.pricing_source: prediction 8: offer price x fully diluted shares per the final prospectus cover; prediction 10: primary-exchange official daily closes
resolution_rules.timezone: America/New_York; dates as printed in the resolving document
resolution_rules.rounding: values compared at the precision the resolving document discloses; a value on a stated boundary counts as inside the bracket
resolution_rules.dispute_resolution: the panel majority verdict is final and published with all dissents; there is no appeal; a material scoring error is handled as a new dated erratum action, never by editing the scorecard
resolution_rules.no_s1_by_deadline: every S-1 prediction resolves unresolvable and is scored as such
resolution_rules.ipo_withdrawn_after_filing: document predictions (1-7, 9) still score against the filed S-1; pricing (8) and path (10) predictions resolve unresolvable
resolution_rules.ambiguous_or_absent_disclosure: the prediction resolves unresolvable, never argued into a hit
resolution_rules.reporting: unresolvable counts against coverage, reported separately from accuracy; both numbers are published
resolution_rules.scored_against: S-1 predictions: first publicly filed Form S-1 incl. financial statements and notes; market predictions: final pricing; path prediction: post-listing daily prices
